Compute Feed Conversion Ratio (FCR) with Confidence Flags

Source: R/calc_fcr.R
calc_fcr.Rd

Compute feed conversion ratio (FCR) from ADG and ADFI over the same body weight stage, flag pigs whose values rely on extrapolation, and summarise the traits.

calc_fcr(adg, adfi, min_coverage = adg$settings$min_coverage, verbose = 1)

Arguments

adg

Result of calc_adg().

adfi

Result of calc_adfi() computed from the same adg.

min_coverage

Minimum share of stage days with recorded feed intake for fcr_flag = "ok". Default: min_coverage of the QC settings (0.7).

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).

Value

An object of class ppt_fcr (a list):

  • per_pig: adg (g/d), adfi (g/d), fcr, gf, adg_type, coverage, stage_days, start_weight, end_weight, fcr_flag, fcr_note;

  • daily: the daily table of calc_adfi();

  • summary: numeric summary (n, min, max, median, mean, sd, cv) of the main traits, for all pigs, for pigs with fcr_flag = "ok" and, with a breed column, for each breed;

  • by_bin: one row per pig and body weight class of bin_width kg: feed (feed_kg), gain (gain_kg), segment fcr, weight_coverage_kg (span of recorded body weights in the class), low_coverage (inner class covered by less than min_bin_coverage_kg) and fcr_out (segment FCR outside bin_fcr_limits);

  • removed, settings.

See also

calc_adg(), calc_adfi().

Examples

visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
adg <- calc_adg(clean_weight(visits, verbose = 0), verbose = 0)
adfi <- calc_adfi(visits, adg, verbose = 0)
fcr <- calc_fcr(adg, adfi)
#> 
#> ── FCR over 30-120 kg ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> ℹ FCR for 29 pigs: 20 ok, 9 low confidence
#> ✔ Mean FCR 2.42 (SD 0.14), ADG 1162 g/d, ADFI 2809 g/d
head(fcr$per_pig[, .(responder, adg, adfi, fcr, fcr_flag, fcr_note)])
#>    responder       adg     adfi      fcr       fcr_flag

#> 3: weight data flagged; weight records cover 5.0 kg of 80-90 kg

fcr$summary[group == "all"]
